DetailsDocument.ProductTitle: CertScore.ai Website Scanner - Free Browser-Based Privacy Scanning
DetailsDocument.ShortDescription: Scan public website URLs in your browser and review evidence-backed privacy risk signals. Includes 50 single-page scans per month, report history, and email support. Requires a CertScore account; no MCP client or API-key configuration.
DetailsDocument.LongDescription:
CertScore.ai Website Scanner lets developers, website owners, and small agencies review public website privacy risk signals directly through the CertScore.ai website. Inspect cookies, trackers, consent controls and eligible consent-choice behavior, public policy disclosures, and other available website observations, with retained evidence and clear coverage limitations.

Subscribe to this free SaaS offering through AWS Marketplace, choose Set up your account, sign in or create a CertScore account, and explicitly link your AWS subscription to the appropriate workspace. Enter a public website URL, run a scan, follow its progress, and open the report in your browser. No MCP client, API key, or resources deployed in your AWS account are required.

Includes 50 single-page scans per calendar month (UTC) for the linked subscription workspace. Each fresh scan covers one submitted public URL; linked policy evidence may be retrieved as part of that scan. Completed-result reuse does not use a new scan credit. Unused credits do not roll over. Existing safety checks, cooldowns, and rate limits apply. This offering does not include unlimited scans, full-site crawling, scheduled monitoring, or additional API/MCP allowances. Existing CertScore paid subscriptions remain separate.

Subscription status, remaining scan allowance, and report history are available in CertScore.ai. Email support is available at support@certscore.ai. Subscription cancellation stops new scans under that subscription; report access follows the applicable access and retention policies. Re-subscribing does not reset the current monthly allowance.

CertScore.ai provides automated observations for human review. Results may be incomplete or incorrect and coverage varies by website. The service does not provide legal advice, certification, proof of compliance, or a substitute for a comprehensive audit. Submit public website URLs only; do not submit credentials, private URLs, or sensitive data.
Highlights: Scan a public website URL and review privacy risk signals and retained evidence directly in the CertScore.ai browser interface.
Free access includes 50 single-page scans per month, report history, subscription and usage visibility, and email support. Limits and coverage restrictions apply.
Subscribe through AWS Marketplace and complete CertScore account setup. No MCP client or API-key configuration is required.
DetailsDocument.SupportDescription:
Email support@certscore.ai for help with AWS Marketplace account setup, subscription linking, website scans, reports, and usage limits. Include your scan ID or the displayed error when available. Never include passwords, registration tokens, credentials, or sensitive URL parameters.

This offering is free of charge; no software purchase fees are collected. For subscription or refund-related questions, contact support@certscore.ai.

Website support: https://certscore.ai/contact
